steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area for the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab, where sourcing actions are available.
Select one open material PR line without selecting service lines.

args.goal: In the selected open material PR row, open Purchase Items, verify that Add to Draft Project is shown, choose it, verify that the draft-project list opens, select an existing draft project, and stop on that draft project's create screen showing the selected PR line has been added

steps.note: Perform the catalog-missing buyer-side Add to Draft Project flow and verify both the option and the resulting line addition.
Assert that selecting the draft project reached its creation screen.
